title: ferriera nivea
intro: Ferriera nivea, commonly known as White Ironwood, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae. This plant has been utilized in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ferriera nivea include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which make it effective in relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and easing respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Ferriera nivea include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
